items.claim: warp narrow domain gets no ticks (A+B; A's first finding and B's second)
log domain inside one decade gets no ticks (A+B; A's second finding and B's fourth)
log ticks in base 2 rounded to 12 significant digits
linear `ticks(NaN)` steps by 1 and can run to millions of ticks

items.note: one shared `tickCount` used by the linear, warp, log and time scales

items.claim: warp/pow `format` disagrees with `tickFormat` (A+B; A's sixth finding and B's third)
month ticks vanish in the first month a Date holds
log `invert` sends every point to an end when the ends' logarithms round equal (A+B; A's eighth finding and B's fifth)
polar `axes: NaN` turns every point to NaN
time ticks hang when the domain's span overflows to Infinity
tick labels at 1e21 or more print float-noise digits
`warpTicks` and the log scale's ticks gave no ticks for a NaN count, and the log scale gave none for `Infinity` either
items.note: with the NaN-count fix above, so not counted separately.

items.claim: `gridOf` kept at most one digit past a value's decade, so 1.15 read "1.2"
items.note: alongside the warp `format` fix, so not counted separately.
